summary: 51 holdings; the top ten are 54% of the portfolio.
Trades moderately: about 31% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 6.7 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced, more profitable, faster-growing and much larger.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 2 of 9 full years.

profile.background: An engineer who began managing money as an analyst in 1996, then founded Giverny Capital in Montreal in 1998.
profile.approach: A small number of high-quality, market-leading companies with owner-managers, bought at about half their expected value in five years and held for about seven years on average.
known: Reported to have returned about 14.5% a year since 1998.
